target.table_description: Foundation Data Product - deduplicated payment transaction events from Teradata source

columns.name: payment_amount
columns.description: Payment amount in GBP, zero when null

sources.ddl_hint: CREATE SET TABLE e_pay_db.payment_raw, NO FALLBACK, NO BEFORE JOURNAL, NO AFTER JOURNAL

code.content: LOCKING ROW FOR ACCESS SELECT pay_id AS payment_id, CAST(ZEROIFNULL(pay_amt) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS payment_amount, OREPLACE(pay_desc, 'LEGACY_', '') AS payment_description, pay_dt AS payment_date FROM e_pay_db.payment_raw QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pay_id ORDER BY load_ts DESC) = 1

configuration.dialect_notes: Source SQL uses Teradata-specific functions: QUALIFY (window filter), ZEROIFNULL (null-to-zero coercion), OREPLACE (string replacement), LOCKING ROW FOR ACCESS (read lock hint). These must be translated to ANSI/Spark equivalents in business_logic.
